procedure_resources.reference_base: relative to the declared SKILL.md; branch/context paths relative to its procedure resource
procedure_resources.source_form: One agentic-procedure fenced JSON object in Markdown
procedure_resources.authoring_boundary: Natural-language criteria and named branches; no per-question answer schema, predicates, loops, retries or effect controls. Exact typed data belongs to domain owners.
procedure_resources.selected_delivery: semantic-routes/discover/v1 arguments.resource selects exact source_ref, skill_id and resource returned by current leaf detail
procedure_resources.capability_scope: Passive admission and selected detail only; semantic answers and owner continuation are separate capabilities.
procedure_resources.currentness: Question source and declared judgment context are revision-bound. Branch destinations remain path-validated references; only a selected destination body is read and added to selected-detail dependencies.

optional: exact repository evidence references with observed revision
procedure_answers.carriage: Exact public answer request; caller-owned, disposable, no global answer storage
procedure_answers.reentry: Lost carriage exposes an unresolved question; changed relevant basis requires reconsideration. Supplied-answer validation establishes protocol/currentness, not semantic truth.
procedure_answers.selection_binding: Selection binds immutable route, source reference, skill identity and question resource revision. The caller chooses the instance at selection time; answer carriage binds that instance as well.
procedure_answers.semantic_material: Reject versioned authority envelopes and nested bare action envelopes containing source_owner, operation_id, arguments, effects and authority. Ordinary prose and JSON remain advisory material.

identity.id: public request id or action operation_id

owner_references.direct_selection: start reference owner:<kind>:<owner>:<id> resolves one exact immutable reference; stable identity alone cannot invoke
owner_references.fragment_selection: One agentic-owner-reference fenced JSON identity in a selected Markdown resource
owner_references.currentness: Exact returned reference binds work context and owner envelope; reobserve before use; missing or ambiguous identities yield. Selection cannot replace arguments, effects or authority.
owner_references.continuation: One resolution step, then yield to existing owner request/answer/invoke. No automatic effect traversal or blind replay; confirmed/uncertain truth and typed continuation remain owner-owned.

activation.source: Optional activation object in the existing agentic-procedure source; no second trigger catalogue
activation.settled_by: Conjunction of exact native view selector/value observations; suppresses optional method only, never grants proof or waives a blocker
activation.entry: Qualified existing skill and procedure resource
activation.judgment: Exact activation public request with independently revision-bound candidate judgments: applicable, unknown, defer, no-match, no-retention
activation.outcome: Selection or reading is never outcome evidence

public_requests.constructibility: owner intention kind plus arguments validated by its declared JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
public_requests.resolution: responsible owner derives a separately declared operation and exact arguments, decision, blocker, or settled response
public_requests.schema_authority: self-contained input_schema in the revision-bound capability contract; external retrieval disabled
public_requests.execution: invoke only the exact returned operation envelope

operating_projections.full: Original current owner views and capability/detail contracts.
operating_projections.compact: Resolve current mandatory owner contributions and exact selected envelopes; defer optional configuration fields, proof alternatives and Planning portability. No required action-detail fetch.
operating_projections.carried: Separate model-facing view and disposable carriage of exact selected actions/questions plus small lazy owner descriptors; no full top-level owner objects. Only the view belongs in model context.
operating_projections.session_capture: Opted-in native transport observation: capturing, identity-unavailable (requirement: AW_SESSION_LOGICAL_IDENTITY), or capture-failed, with authoritative: false. Absent when disabled. Attached after capture to the result or carried model-facing view, never semantic inputs or immutable carriage. Replaces the previous observation without warnings or history; recovery is prospective.
reference_identity: exact immutable action/question envelope, or lazy owner source identity
operating_projections.admission: References are opaque identity, not authority. Rust addresses selected owner detail before optional hydration, reobserves mandatory dependency contributions, and executes exact actions through current native admission. Compact/carried post-effect continuation uses the same frontier boundary.
operating_projections.bounded_answer: Fill only the absent answer slot of the exact current selected decision; preserve every supplied owner argument.
operating_projections.context: Carry unchanged target/task/changed/request; explicit differences require fresh start.
operating_projections.source_delivery: Optional delivered refs suppress only exact unchanged source prose after fresh owner resolution. delivery_refs bind work, source material and producing implementation. They never acknowledge understanding, reconciliation, proof or effects.
operating_projections.recovery: Unknown, changed or lost carriage requires fresh source-owner resolution; no durable registry.

capability_ownership.effects: bound to one owned domain and admitted operation
capability_ownership.claims: exclusive authority declared separately from a module contribution
capability_ownership.cross_owner_results: evidence only until the responsible owner admits a typed request

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Add or refresh AW in this repository; show the proposal and ask before writing.

commands.name: worker
commands.description: Project bounded worker entry, expand an exact captured input, or assemble unproven return re-entry from a sealed Assignment packet.

commands.name: resources
commands.description: Propose with a resource request; execute by passing the exact returned action envelope unchanged to --input. Explicit context flags must match; omitted context comes from the envelope.

commands.name: invoke
commands.description: Invoke the exact operation returned by the current owner.

commands.name: activation-index
commands.description: Check or derive a repository registry activation index from its procedure sources; explicit authoring only.

options.description: Current task text; semantics remain agent-owned.
Changed paths; accepts multiple values and repetition.
Output format: setup defaults to text; machine commands use json.
Compact executable decision (default), full detail, or view plus disposable exact carriage for a thin host.
Exact immutable reference from carried output; --input supplies the machine-carried object.
JSON bounded answer for an exact carried decision reference; all owner material remains unchanged.
Exact delivery_refs already held by this continuing consumer; suppress unchanged source prose only, never owner checks or obligations.
JSON input file, or - for stdin; start accepts one current owner request or a bounded array; invoke requires an exact action.
Authorise the exact setup proposal (setup only).
Show the setup proposal without changes (setup only).
Inspect and authorise an interrupted setup (setup only).

authority.data_shapes: this JSON contract and referenced JSON Schema

memory_consequences.selected_advice: Current selected small notes are delivered as bounded advisory_context; active proof procedure or explicit detail expands selected large notes. No disposition or authority is inferred.
memory_consequences.capture_recovery: One exact recoverable interrupted owner transaction exposes its existing recovery action after current scope, policy and custody admission. Original publications are not automatically replayed.

future_value_signal.source: Admitted native Verification receipt, complete JSON stdout up to 8192 bytes
future_value_signal.authority: Untrusted nomination only; agent supplies materiality and strongest-owner disposition, existing capture owner requires publication authorization.
future_value_signal.continuity: Exact Verification prerequisites travel in the disposition request; an unresolved candidate restricts claim:complete. No signal is quiet.

dispatch_revalidation.dependency_carriage: Include delivered startup source requests before sealing handoffs and Planning continuations; invoke revalidates the exact returned dependency set.
dispatch_revalidation.recovery: Bounded error.dependency and error.recovery_owner identify the first failing boundary. Resolve fresh owner requests through start; never blindly retry a dispatch or infer absent effects after effect-owner entry.
dispatch_revalidation.privacy: Diagnostic fields contain no submitted or expected packet, prompt, path or provider values. Existing caller-supplied recovery custody remains separate.

execution_continuity.binding_dispatch: Carry exact ready dispatch only for binding nonlocal current Assignment and supported selected transport; no automatic invoke. Exact in-flight custody blocks relaunch.
execution_continuity.planning_continuity: Current admitted owner custody carries exact sealed-handoff retention, admitted integrated return adoption and same-owner pending-update recovery. Semantic relation, selector permission and new plan material remain explicit.
execution_continuity.no_op: Identical retained handoff or consumed result does not synthesize a new durable update.
execution_continuity.authority: No new proof, worker-result trust, completion or source admission.

language_facade.authority: Exact native request envelopes; language adapters only name, serialize and transport.
language_facade.resources_disposition: Common API: the standard task-resource skill needs bounded lifecycle composition from either language host.

current_material.authority: none; labels never establish truth, permission, policy or proof
current_material.currentness: Optional work must match current work; exact repository dependency reference/revision pairs are reobserved. External currentness remains unverified.
current_material.retention: Explicit disposable carriage only; task identity excludes material.
